Truth for every bucket, category and indicator comes from _money_in_truth and indicator_truth; TRUTH_THRESHOLDS match src/cma/thresholds/indicators.yaml. Byte identity: with no features the only category change is gated on `features` (L283), _NON_TRADING_IN holds only OTHER among the non-feature events, and Truth.to_json drops the new fields. Proven by test_p17_byte_identity_of_existing_archetypes_and_profiles (invariants-5.log:904 PASSED) and independently by the existing generator-drift hash check at tests/test_rules.py:489 (dual_run-7 passed, file not in the diff). The CLI path (cli.py:61-78) is covered by test_generate_cli_writes_the_featured_case (contracts-4.log:639 PASSED). Evals were extended (behavioural-6: 9/9 featured cases match truth).

tests/test_synth_features.py checks, on both accounts, every line's category, M17, every bucket with its ids (M2, M19-M25), M18 and every indicator's (kind, evidence) against truth. It runs all 9 archetype x profile pairs with all features, each single feature and two pairs at seeds/lengths (3,12),(11,6),(5,24) across all archetypes, plus the at-limit boundary of exactly 2500.00 flagged and 2499.99 not. invariants-5.log shows the P17 tests passed (e.g. line 865), 955 passed with no failures; evals feature_mismatches is shown to be non-vacuous (contracts-4.log:640). Checked against how the system computes: case figures are per account (src/cma/overrides.py:345) and no own-account pairing code exists, so per-account truth is what the system produces.

findings.claim: When 'all' is among the --feature values, every other value is silently dropped, so an unknown feature name given beside 'all' is not refused. The claim says an unknown --feature is refused with exit 2.
findings.repro: cma generate --out /tmp/x --feature all --feature crypto: exits 0 and writes the full featured case, while `--feature crypto` alone exits 2 with 'unknown feature'. Fix: validate the non-'all' values with synth.generate's check before expanding 'all'.
